```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Real.log ↑(n + 1) ≤ ↑(harmonic n) := by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.pos_add_one 0)
  · rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, harmonic_succ]
    apply le_trans
    · apply Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (Real.pos_add_one 0)
    · exact hd
```
